purpose: Preserve every v2 transfer requirement while defining an explicit stability gate for deterministic local heads

stochastic_head.protocol: Use the component_transfer_gate_v2 stochastic seed-31415 repeat on the best and worst primary-seed folds

deterministic_head.reason: A random-seed repeat is undefined for a deterministic solver; row-order permutation checks numerical and serialization stability without changing the estimator
